mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, we are seeing overcast skies at Verona Community Park with a temperature of 46 degrees, an overnight low of 43, and rain is expected overnight under our New Moon phase.

The City of Verona is working on the Mark Drive Reconstruction project, which includes updates to water mains, sanitary sewers, and new sidewalk installations between Nine Mound Road and Westlawn Avenue.
There is plenty to do, with trivia happening today at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music and yoga classes coming up tomorrow.
In a noteworthy incident from the past week, officers arrested a man for O W I on October 25 after he was found stopped at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Stop by for today's Flavor of the Day, Chocolate Heath Crunch; the restaurant is open until 10:00 PM tonight.
